requirements.text: Students should be able to check book availability online.
Students should be able to manage their loans online, including borrowing, returning, and renewing items.
Manual librarian intervention is required for exceptions such as overdue items with requests from others or outstanding fines.
The study room booking system must allow students to select date, time slot, and room capacity online.
A mechanism must be in place to manage conflicts or double bookings, requiring librarian oversight.
The system must retain a personal service aspect, allowing librarians to step in when necessary.
Reports on loan volumes and popular items must be generated for librarians to manage inventory effectively.
Reports on room utilization must be generated to understand how often study spaces are booked and used.
Reports on fines revenue must be generated to assist in policy enforcement and financial oversight.
Data handling must ensure accuracy and oversight to maintain reliability in reporting.
The system must integrate well as a whole, ensuring new features work together cohesively.
